## Activity

During December 2023, Hill Counties Health Centre completed 97 captures. This records the imaging activity undertaken at the site during the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures reported below. The activity level should be considered alongside the number of images available for assessment and the time taken to complete grading.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 6 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 6.2 per cent. The result should be reviewed as part of routine quality monitoring, with attention given to image acquisition and any recurring equipment or camera issues that may affect the ability to produce assessable images. Any concerns should be recorded through the service desk so they can be followed up.

## Grading

Grading identified 17 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that the central grading process generally provided a prompt review of submitted images during the reporting period. The site should continue to monitor both grading timeliness and image quality, and use the findings to support consistent operational practice.
